Teaching Knowledge Visualizer 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides teachers with tools to convert knowledge points, chapter content, and textbook text into interactive, classroom-ready HTML visualizations.
- Supports nine visualization types, including concept maps, mind maps, flowcharts, timelines, comparison matrices, and more.
- Features include interactive illustration pages (with zoom, pan, dynamic parameters), self-contained offline HTML (no external dependencies), and high-contrast, projection-ready layouts.
- Ensures all materials comply with academic conventions (ISO 80000 for math/physics symbols, standard fraction rendering, structured knowledge hierarchies).
- Integrates automatic background self-checks for knowledge accuracy, layout clarity, and interactive correctness prior to delivery.
- Suitable for primary/secondary and higher education teachers for lesson prep, classroom instruction, review, and student self-study.
